prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps was helpful in 3 winning tests (+9.0%, +4.3%, and +4.8% after noise correction), while 5 tests showed no clear effect and 1 was worse.
Adding a new screen to adoption was harmful, as both tests agreed on a negative impact after noise correction (-2.4% and -10.3%).
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign and finish new_screen changes because their tests disagreed after noise correction.
Evidence is still thin for adoption hint, home new_flow, and choose_path reorder changes because each has only 1 test.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, particularly for tests with no clear effect or those stopped early.
Predictions were too low for the round 2 finish new_screen test (+8.0% predicted vs +9.8% noise-corrected) and round 8 sign_in reorder test (+0.8% predicted vs +9.0% noise-corrected).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: -5.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_screen: -5.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -4.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: -2.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -10.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.4% after noise correction, 9 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 87.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Post Onboarding Quick Reference Card Screen: Adds a new screen 'new_quick_reference' right after home_intro detailing essential mouse and keyboard controls. (why: Support received multiple tickets asking how to hide, control, or talk to the pet after completing setup.)
1: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Split Story Card Redesign: Redesigns home_intro into a split layout displaying desktop pet behavior tips alongside the companion mascot. (why: Finish step mean duration is very long (5815s) and users complain about post-onboarding confusion regarding pet behavior.)
2: [adoption, hint] Upload Photos Validation Tips Hint: Adds file upload format guidance on the upload_photos screen to prevent rendering errors. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results during adoption.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Background Generation Progress Notice: Adds a progress bar and step counter on the waiting screen to give visual feedback during pet creation. (why: The waiting screen has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing uncertainty while waiting.)
4: [sign_in, incentive] Sign-In Account Cloud Sync Protection Badge: Displays a cloud synchronization badge on the sign_in screen informing users of automatic data protection. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing after signing in again, making cloud sync guarantees critical.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Warm Welcome Copy Clarification: Updates the story intro headline and body text to set clear, friendly expectations before path selection. (why: Choose_path step has a 23.8% drop-off; setting early expectations improves completion.)
6: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Trait Cards Redesign: Redesigns pick_friend with a card layout highlighting companion personalities and visual options. (why: Adoption drop-off is the largest in the funnel (60.9% conversion), requiring stronger companion engagement.)
7: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Completion Desktop Notification Toggle: Enables notification options on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering completes. (why: Median waiting time is 201s (mean 2336s); desktop notification prevents users from abandoning while waiting.)
